mutant.lineText: const isScalar = (v: unknown): v is string | number | boolean => typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'boolean' || (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v));
mutant.prevText: const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
